title: Plan and apply: reviewing the change before applying it

videos.script: Ana changed four things in the shop's configuration and asked Terraform what would happen. The answer was a page of symbols. A plus, a tilde, a minus, and one that was both at once. {{symbols}} At the bottom sat one line: four to add, one to change, two to destroy. That line is where most people stop reading. It cannot tell a deletion from a rebuild. {{summary}} This lesson is about reading the proposal before it becomes the act. You will save a plan to a file, so the plan you review is the plan that runs. And you will watch Terraform refuse one that went stale. {{saved}} Then you will read the plan as data, and write a short guard that fails on any delete. Some changes no guard catches, like a rule opened to the whole internet. For those there is a reviewer's checklist. {{review}} Last come two things that go wrong after you say yes. An apply that fails halfway and keeps what it made. And the target flag, which looks precise and quietly leaves changes behind. {{failure}}
